reuse.why: The rule change is made inside the existing shared helpers getRangeAmount/getExpectedAmount, which every consumer (forecast, schedule-template, schedules app, UI via getScheduledAmount) already calls, and it keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the change simplifies two expressions in place.

placement.why: The amount rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it.

scope.why: Only the helper, its comments, its tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Smaller, clearer one-line rules with updated docs and tests; only a minor comment typo ('the end of lowest value').
